## What lands

The guarded, auditable cleanup path for the four ratified BL-38 residue families — and its
**live execution against prod** under the operator's 2026-10-15T23:45Z full pre-authorization.
Dry-run → verbatim committed itemized list → scope verdict → pre-state row dumps → bounded
deletes in one transaction → post-state verification. Two of the four ratified categories were
already absent (the scheduled hard-delete/purge pipeline had handled them); the apply deleted
**exactly 3 rows** — nothing outside the itemized list.

- **`scripts/live/cleanup-bl38-residue.mjs`** — system-role DSN only; `--dry-run` is the
  default and emits the itemized target set with row-level evidence + a scope verdict;
